about: [O1b critic] what lies near the Grand Ave start (the item spots by kind, nearest first) and what the street dressing counts

steps.eval: (() => { const I = G.stage.part('items'); const p = N.controller.pos; const by = {}; for (const it of I.list) by[it.kind] = (by[it.kind]||0)+1; const near = I.list.map(it => ({k: it.kind, x: +it.x.toFixed(1), y:+it.y.toFixed(2), z: +it.z.toFixed(1), d: +Math.hypot(it.x-p.x, it.z-p.z).toFixed(0), place: it.place||''})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d); const firsts = {}; for (const n of near) if (!firsts[n.k]) firsts[n.k] = n; return JSON.stringify({by, total: I.list.length, firsts, near: near.slice(0,8)}); })()
